{{Top}}
{{Quote|The sergeant is the army.|[[Bric/Legends|Bric]], a trainer with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_Sergeant.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Imperial sergeant leading a squad of stormtroopers]]
In [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-based military organizations, a '''sergeant''' was a non-commissioned [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Military rank/Legends|rank]]ing above a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] and below a [[Warrant Officer/Legends|Warrant Officer]]. Sergeants served as [[Squad/Legends|squad]] leaders, or as assistants to commissioned officers commanding larger units and formations. Sergeants formed the backbone of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. The rank of sergeant was also a part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Army/Legends|army]] in the [[New Sith Wars]]. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] was once a sergeant. In the ranks of the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]], the rank of sergeant was called ''ruus'alor''.

The rank could and would also be utilized by members of a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]].<ref name="Inv">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
